judgment.notes: N006 is used on mean-zero L2 inputs and on H1 products in its stated domains. A001 instantiates E005 at the smooth twisted Scheme iterate, positive tau and nonnegative grid index; the exact update and remainder conventions are supplied in E005 itself. The routine background applications have the conditions recorded in BG001-BG004.

S001 gives a bounded multilinear construction: Ftau is quadratic into H1 and every Htau term is cubic into L2; coefficients are finite for fixed tau>0. Zero modes and conjugate symmetry give the preservation claims. S002 uses E005 and cancels Q_n against W_n at the right endpoint. In S003, the three differentiated integrals sum to B_t(z_n,z_n)/2; symmetry and bilinearity of B give exactly the two Y_n correction terms. Since rho_n(t_n)=0, its finite concatenation is continuous and differentiates as stated away from the finite grid.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
